about: The release gate's baseline: each published model's task sample, run through sidekickd over HTTP, on the paths and build variants listed. Written by tools/release_gate.py --update-baseline; do not edit by hand. A change to it is deliberate, and its PR says why.

accuracy.about: task accuracy (MNLI, gold labels, relevant top document)

agreement.about: share of items whose prediction matches fp32's

flips.about: share of items whose prediction differs from the baseline run's

mean_prob.about: mean probability of the predicted label (catches drift without flips)

error.about: 1 - worst cosine with fp32 (embedders), largest |score - fp32| (rerankers)

sanity.about: each class probability in the textbook MNLI triple

chat_score.about: a chat-benchmark family's headline score (mode:family), over 12 items

exact.about: counts that must not change: refused requests, token-count mismatches, sanity verdicts, probs/nli_probs disagreements
